title: Signed small-model evaluation of derived colimits on polynomial resolutions
statement:
Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ and a bound as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of $\mathcal U$-small commutative rings and let $\mathcal D_{B/A}$ be the category of all $\mathcal U$-small polynomial $A$-algebras $T=A[E]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] with an $A$-algebra map $\epsilon_T:T\to B$ (not necessarily surjective), and $A$-algebra maps over $B$. Let $\mathcal D\subseteq\mathcal D_{B/A}$ be a full subcategory that is small in the working universe, with inclusion $i$, and put $\mathcal C=\mathcal D^{op}$ with the identity-cover topology. Let $P_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}B$ be an augmented simplicial $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] with every $P_n$ in $\mathcal D$, whose underlying simplicial-set augmentation is a trivial Kan fibration [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration]. For a commutative ring $R$ and an $R$-module presheaf $F$ on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], that is a functor $F:\mathcal D\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$, put $s(F(P_\bullet))^{-n}=F(P_n)$ with differential $\sum_i(-1)^iF(d_i)$ and zero positive terms. Let $K_{\mathcal C}(F)$ be the bar model of $L\pi^R_{\mathcal C,!}F$ of [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar], whose face $d_j$ deletes $U_{n-j}$ of $U_n\to\cdots\to U_0$, and let $a_{P,F}:s(F(P_\bullet))\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf H(\mathcal D,F)$ be the comparison of [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation] with its bar model $K_{\mathcal D}(F)$, whose face $d_j$ deletes $T_j$ of $T_0\to\cdots\to T_n$.
(1) The two models have the same summand $F(U_0)=F(T_0)$ indexed by $U_n\to\cdots\to U_0$ in $\mathcal C$, that is $T_0\to\cdots\to T_n$ in $\mathcal D$ with $T_i=U_i$, and multiplication by $(-1)^{n(n+1)/2}$ in degree $-n$ is an isomorphism of complexes $j_F:K_{\mathcal C}(F)\to K_{\mathcal D}(F)$. It is the identity in degree zero, respects the augmentations, and commutes with every bar-chain map induced by a functor and a semilinear coefficient transformation. The isomorphism
$$\alpha_{P,F}=j_F^{-1}a_{P,F}:s(F(P_\bullet))\xrightarrow{\sim}L\pi^R_{\mathcal C,!}F\quad\text{in }D(R)$$
[def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is natural in $F$ and in augmented simplicial maps $h:P\to Q$ between such resolutions: $\alpha_{Q,F}\,s(F(h))=\alpha_{P,F}$.
(2) If $F=F^{\mathrm{big}}\circ i$ for a functor $F^{\mathrm{big}}:\mathcal D_{B/A}\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$ and $a^{\mathrm{big}}_P:s(F^{\mathrm{big}}(P_\bullet))\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf H(\mathcal D_{B/A},F^{\mathrm{big}})$ is the comparison of [lem-trf-polynomial-presentation-homology], then $a^{\mathrm{big}}_P=\mathbf H(i,\mathrm{id})\,a_{P,F}$. Consequently, for two such resolutions $P,Q$ in $\mathcal D$, $\alpha_{Q,F}^{-1}\alpha_{P,F}=(a^{\mathrm{big}}_Q)^{-1}a^{\mathrm{big}}_P$.
(3) Let $A'\to B'$, $\mathcal D'\subseteq\mathcal D_{B'/A'}$ and $P'$ be data of the same kind, $\mathcal C'=\mathcal D'^{op}$, $v:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$ any functor, $\rho:R\to R'$ a ring map, $G$ an $R'$-module presheaf on $\mathcal C'$, $t:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho(G\circ v)$ a natural transformation and $k:vP\to P'$ a morphism of simplicial objects of $\mathcal D'$. Then, after restriction of scalars to $R$,
$$\alpha_{P',G}\,s(G(k)t_P)=L\pi_!(v^{op},t)\,\alpha_{P,F},$$
where $L\pi_!(v^{op},t)$ is the map given by the bar-chain formula of [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. No contractibility, resolution or flatness hypothesis on $vP$ is imposed.

source.place: Tags 08PS (lemma-identify-pi-shriek), 08PT (lemma-pi-shriek-standard), 08QI (remark-resolution), 08QL (section-functoriality); sites-cohomology Tags 08PG (example-left-derived-colimits), 08PH (example-morphism-categories), 08Q9 (lemma-compute-by-cosimplicial-resolution). Carries original sheaf-model proof Step 1 (bar sign), Step 4 (evaluation), the small-model transport of Step 5 and the signed reindexing of Step 8; Steps 2-3 are carried by lem-trf-polynomial-augmentation-boundary and lem-trf-polynomial-presentation-homology.

proof.text: Identify a string $U_n\to\cdots\to U_0$ in $\mathcal C$ with $T_0\to\cdots\to T_n$ in $\mathcal D$, $T_i=U_i$. The coefficient modules coincide. By [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar] and [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation], face $j$ in $K_{\mathcal C}$ is face $n-j$ in $K_{\mathcal D}$, including the coefficient map: deleting $U_0=T_0$ applies $F(T_0\to T_1)$ in both. Thus on degree $-n$, for $n\geq1$, $d_{\mathcal C}=\sum_{j=0}^n(-1)^j\partial_{n-j}=(-1)^n d_{\mathcal D}$. Put $\lambda_n=(-1)^{n(n+1)/2}$. Since $\lambda_n=(-1)^n\lambda_{n-1}$, $d_{\mathcal D}\lambda_n=\lambda_{n-1}d_{\mathcal C}$. Multiplication by $\lambda_n$ is therefore the asserted chain map $j_F$, and the same degreewise formula is its inverse since $\lambda_n^2=1$. Positive degrees are zero.

In degree zero $\lambda_0=1$, so $j_F$ preserves the cocone augmentation to $\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal D}F$: it leaves every generator $(T_0,x)$ unchanged. For any functor $v$ and semilinear transformation $t$, both bar formulas send $(T_0\to\cdots\to T_n,x)$ to $(vT_0\to\cdots\to vT_n,t_{T_0}(x))$. Additivity gives $t_{T_0}(\lambda_nx)=\lambda_nt_{T_0}(x)$, also after scalar restriction. Hence $j_GK_{\mathcal C}(v^{op},t)=K_{\mathcal D}(v,t)j_F$ as chain maps. The same calculation covers coefficient transformations alone.

Fullness of $\mathcal D\subseteq\mathcal D_{B/A}$ makes $P$ a simplicial object of $\mathcal D$ and identifies $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(T,P_\bullet)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D_{B/A}}(T,P_\bullet)$, commuting with all simplicial operators. For every $T\in\mathcal D$, [lem-trf-polynomial-presentation-homology] says that this latter simplicial set is homotopy equivalent to a singleton: apply its representable assertion to $Q=P$, whose polynomial terms and trivial Kan augmentation are precisely our hypotheses. This does not require $T\to B$ to be surjective. Therefore $P$ satisfies the representable contractibility hypothesis of [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation] in the working-universe-small category $\mathcal D$.

Apply [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation] to step 3. It gives the canonical isomorphism $a_{P,F}$ with target the first-vertex bar model. By [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar], $K_{\mathcal C}(F)$ represents $L\pi^R_{\mathcal C,!}F$; step 1 identifies it with that first-vertex model. Consequently $\alpha_{P,F}=j_F^{-1}a_{P,F}$ is an isomorphism in $D(R)$. Naturality of $a$ in $F$ and step 2 give naturality of $\alpha$ in $F$. If $h:P\to Q$ is an augmented resolution map, step 3 applies to $Q$ as well; in the cited comparison formula set $u=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$, $\rho=\mathrm{id}_R$, $\theta=\mathrm{id}_F$, $k=h$. Its bar map is the identity on every generator, so $a_{Q,F}s(F(h))=a_{P,F}$. Multiplication by $j_F^{-1}$ gives the required equality for $\alpha$.

Suppose $F=F^{\mathrm{big}}i$. By [lem-trf-polynomial-presentation-homology], $P$ satisfies representable contractibility also in the containing-universe-small $\mathcal D_{B/A}$, and its $a^{\mathrm{big}}_P$ is the canonical comparison with the first-vertex bar model. In [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation] take $u=i$, $F'=F^{\mathrm{big}}$, $\rho=\mathrm{id}_R$, $\theta=\mathrm{id}$ and $k:\!iP\to P$ the identity. Both source and target satisfy its hypotheses by step 3 and the cited large-category assertion. Its formula gives $a^{\mathrm{big}}_P=\mathbf H(i,\mathrm{id})a_{P,F}$. Apply the same argument to $Q$.

Write $M=\mathbf H(i,\mathrm{id})$. Step 5 gives $a^{\mathrm{big}}_P=Ma_{P,F}$ and $a^{\mathrm{big}}_Q=Ma_{Q,F}$. Since these comparison maps are isomorphisms, $M=a^{\mathrm{big}}_P a_{P,F}^{-1}$ is an isomorphism as well. Cancellation now yields $(a^{\mathrm{big}}_Q)^{-1}a^{\mathrm{big}}_P=a_{Q,F}^{-1}M^{-1}Ma_{P,F}=a_{Q,F}^{-1}a_{P,F}=\alpha_{Q,F}^{-1}\alpha_{P,F}$, the last equality using $\alpha_{P,F}=j_F^{-1}a_{P,F}$ and the same $j_F$ for $P,Q$.

source.place: Tag 08Q9 (lemma-compute-by-cosimplicial-resolution); cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms

proof.text: For the data of (3), repeat step 3 in $\mathcal D'$ for $P'$. Apply the general compatibility statement of [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-colimit-computation] with $u=v$, $F'=G$, $\theta=t$ and the given $k:vP\to P'$. It gives $a_{P',G}s(G(k)t_P)=\mathbf H(v,t)a_{P,F}$ after restriction to $R$; its statement expressly requires no contractibility of $vP$. Step 2 and the generator formula of [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar] identify $j_G^{-1}\mathbf H(v,t)=L\pi_!(v^{op},t)j_F^{-1}$ under the displayed bar models. Multiply the first equality on the left by $j_G^{-1}$ and substitute $\alpha=j^{-1}a$ to obtain exactly (3). Restricting scalars preserves the degreewise sign maps, and the cited general compatibility includes restriction of scalars on its comparisons. No flatness or resolution property of $vP$ is used.
